finding.summary: Filtered file children are materialized before one concatenation
finding.explanation: The filtered Children sequence is converted to an array, then consumed exactly once by Concat before the combined result is materialized. The intermediate array is avoidable, but this is test-only recursive manifest setup.

finding.summary: Recursive directory results are materialized before one concatenation
finding.explanation: The SelectMany result is converted to an array and then consumed exactly once by Concat before the final result is materialized, creating a distinct avoidable intermediate array in test-only manifest setup.
